insider_activity.interpretation: Insider selling concentrated in Aug-Oct 2025 at $480-560 range (near highs). The notable Feb 2026 buy by Director Joly at ~$399 (post-earnings dip) is a positive signal -- board-level buying at depressed prices. Overall pattern: routine selling near highs, selective buying near lows.

valuation_context.note: As of early March 2026, SPGI trades around $452, down ~22% from 52-week high. Forward P/E ~23x is the cheapest SPGI has traded on a forward basis in many years. Upcoming Mobility spin-off expected to simplify business.
